ideas.pitch: A design system generation tool specifically built to instantly convert hand-drawn wireframes into production-ready Figma component tokens during rapid offline sprints.
ideas.title: AuraUI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a 6-hour UI/UX speed run prioritize exceptional craft, speed, and workflow efficiency over generic concepts.

ideas.pitch: An interactive micro-interaction prototyping suite that lets designers test complex state transitions and haptic feedback profiles instantly inside Figma.
ideas.title: MicroFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the detailed micro-interactions that win UI/UX hackathons where static screens are standard.

ideas.pitch: A real-time contrast, color blindness, and ergonomic accessibility checker plugin for design software that grades interfaces on a 6-dimension UX rubric.
ideas.title: InclusiLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to strict UI/UX evaluation rubrics by quantifying accessibility metrics that judges look for.

ideas.pitch: A contextual layout engine that dynamically rearranges complex enterprise data-dense dashboards based on user intent and hierarchical information scent.
ideas.title: DataCanvas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real-world enterprise UX clutter problems with a polished, portfolio-ready layout system.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered typographic scale and spatial rhythm auditor that optimizes readability and visual hierarchy across multi-breakpoint responsive layouts.
ideas.title: TypeTweak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an immediately demonstrable workflow improvement that UI/UX judges can test live during the presentation.
